summary: Created `inventorysvc` on node1 as a locked system account with `/var/lib/inventory` as its home and `/usr/sbin/nologin` as its shell. The configuration persisted across the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Created system user and dedicated group `inventorysvc` with UID/GID 987.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed from `151be410-d69a-4b38-8176-ab1916aae036` to `dc081434-7f31-4111-a182-03fce7914805`.
Verified the account, locked status, home directory, ownership, and login denial after restart.

evidence.summary: Directly shows system-range UID 987, dedicated group, and locked password before and after restart.
Passwd entry and filesystem metadata show the exact home path, owned by inventorysvc.
Shell is `/usr/sbin/nologin`; direct login attempts were rejected with exit status 1 before and after restart.
Captures the healthy pre-restart account baseline and old boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, new boot ID, and complete post-restart account/home recovery proof.
